people-ops: Quick org update — Maya Chen will join Redwood Inference on 2026-09-14 as Head of Customer Integrations (new role). Maya will centralize Dedicated & Private onboarding playbooks and own the cross-functional runbook for account rollouts. We'll convert one contractor Solutions Engineer into a perm hire and backfill two IC platform roles. Welcome Maya! :tada:

Maya Chen: Really excited to join the team. First 30 days: audit onboarding playbooks, meet major account leads, and run a 1-week shadow of current onboarding runs. Hoping to reduce time-to-first-success for Dedicated by 20% in Q4.

Aisha Patel: Congrats Maya! Hiring notes: two platform IC backfills (ENG-INT-701 & ENG-INT-702) are reallocated; Solutions Engineer contractor will convert to a perm HC (CONV-SEA-001). I'll post req owners and JD drafts this afternoon.

Diego Morales: Maya — great to have you. I'll hand over the current rollout schedule and a short list of accounts with active pilots. Target handoff: 2026-09-14 to 2026-10-01.

Evan Carter: Budget check — are the two IC backfills net-new or reorg? CFO needs headcount alignment for Q4.

people-ops: Evan — both platform IC roles are backfills (reallocated from integration budget). The Solutions Engineer conversion is an approved permanent slot. HC codes: ENG-INT-701/702 (backfills), SE-CONV-001 (conversion).

Sofia Ramos: For the conversion, can we run internal-first referrals for 4 business days? There are a couple of contractors already doing similar work.

Aisha Patel: Yes, internal-first for 4 business days. Interview flow for backfills: 1) internal screen, 2) technical deep-dive (systems + infra), 3) cross-functional panel (product + cs + people-ops). HiringBot — please create GH openings and set referral window.

HiringBot: Reminder: create Greenhouse jobs with tags "customer-integrations" and "dedicated-onboarding". Internal referral window: 4 business days. Rubrics due: 2026-07-20.

Maya Chen: Interview focus for managers/leads: cross-team coordination, playbook-as-code experience, and evidence of simplifying complex launches. For ICs, prioritize experience with rollout infra and canary tooling.

Diego Morales: I'll prepare the transfer doc with open action items, current playbooks, and a `rollout-checklist.md` snippet: 
```
# rollout-checklist
- account kickoff
- infra provisioned
- canary plan
- health checks & SLAs
- handover to CS
```

Aisha Patel: Onboarding link: https://redwood.company/onboarding/customer-integrations — please drop any bespoke notes under "Maya Chen onboarding". Compensation: Head of Customer Integrations = L6. People-ops will share offer framework.

Evan Carter: Please flag any account rollouts that need exec visibility during the handoff window. We should avoid surprise escalations.

Maya Chen: Will do. I'll share a 30/60/90 and set up office hours in week 1. DMs open for syncs.

people-ops: Action items: Aisha to post req owners + HC codes; HiringBot to create GH openings and remind teams for rubrics; Diego to publish handoff doc by 2026-09-10; Maya to share 30/60/90 on start day. Welcome Maya! :confetti_ball:
